title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 28, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.7 (Peaked November 28, 2026 at 06:41 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 584 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Someone left the solar fan on high. ☀️🚀👀

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
